requirements1832.publicPlanRequirement:
| 发现 | 证据 | 动作 | 禁止 |
|---|---|---|---|
| miss_streak>=2 | Future rows | mutation/fusion/new family priority | 新生直接REAL |
| residual bias | ResidualMatrix | threshold/weight/calibration研究 | 改历史命中 |
| regime drift | Drift+Regime | regime gate mutation / degrade | 偷换训练窗口 |
| high error correlation | DiversityMatrix | 拒绝融合/引入异质家族 | A+B/2伪融合 |
| atom contribution≈0 | ablation OOS | downweight/retire atom | 只看train相关性 |
| calibration ECE高 | fixed validation | new calibration study/model | 把raw confidence当概率 |
| latency过高 | LatencyMatrix | 降复杂度/预计算 | 跳过证书门 |

public final class CertificatePolicy { public Decision evaluate(Metrics m){ if(!m.integrity) return Decision.reject("INTEGRITY"); if(m.futureN<360) return Decision.inconclusive("SMALL_N"); if(m.hitRate<0.34) return Decision.reject("HR"); if(m.lcb<=0.30) return Decision.inconclusive("LCB_BASELINE"); if(m.ece>0.04) return Decision.reject("CALIBRATION"); if(m.formalWindows<2) return Decision.inconclusive("WINDOWS"); return Decision.pass(); } public static final class Metrics{public int futureN,formalWindows; public double hitRate,lcb,ece; public boolean integrity;} public static final class Decision{public String state,reason; static Decision pass(){return d("PASS","");} static Decision reject(String r){return d("REJECTED",r);} static Decision inconclusive(String r){return d("INCONCLUSIVE",r);} static Decision d(String s,String r){Decision x=new Decision();x.state=s;x.reason=r;return x;}} }
